method: Production stock prefab vs original RCCP control; actual full-throttle straight acceleration and braking with no gear/RPM/speed seeding. Separate labelled neutral/reverse, external ownership and airborne fixtures.
checks: Two stock Generic cars, unchanged wheel/rigidbody/gear ratios and power, same flat road, full throttle; original RCCP control vs production Formula controller.
Production car reached eighth gear using its automatic decisions; no speed, RPM or gear seeding during acceleration.
Natural 1–8 acceleration and 8–1 braking: seven upshifts and seven downshifts, no skipped gear or hunting, bounded limiter dwell and prompt clutch engagement.
Neutral disengages the clutch; a public reverse request followed by normal reversed pedal input drives the car backwards.
Controlled airborne high-RPM fixture does not upshift. External override and component disable restore original RCCP ownership and tuning.
